notes.title: Reveal Trailer and Steam Scream Fest 3D
notes.content:
[h1]Reveal Trailer[/h1]
We're thrilled to finally pull back the veil on WRAIN with our first official trailer! As part of Steam Scream Fest, we invite you to glimpse into our supernatural puzzle adventure where death is just the beginning.

[previewyoutube=nDH2QWMHZRg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Steam Scream Festival[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006460/5b966f751bfc997b728bd593be9e80cd12210320.png[/img]
Speaking of Scream Fest, we're excited to be participating and can't wait to hear what you think of WRAIN! Your feedback and support mean everything to us as we continue development.
Master death, unravel mysteries, and explore a world where every end is a new beginning. Don't forget to add WRAIN to your wishlist if you want to stay updated on our journey into the unknown!

[i]The island may open its gates to a select few mortals sooner than you think...[/i]

[h1]Join our growing community:[/h1]
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/gQQ2v7xSJ8]https://discord.gg/gQQ2v7xSJ8[/url]
X (Twitter): [url=https://x.com/WrainGame]https://x.com/WrainGame[/url]
Website: [url=synergydigital.co.nz/wrain]synergydigital.co.nz/wrain[/url]

[h2]About WRAIN[/h2]
WRAIN is a single-player cosmic adventure where your end is just the beginning. Solve intricate puzzles to appease Death, gain forbidden knowledge, and unravel the dark secrets of a mysterious island. Tread carefully—or else you may become another lost voice in the chorus of the damned.
The mysteries await...
[i]~ The WRAIN Team[/i]

notes.title: We're in the Made in NZ Games Festival!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that WRAIN has been selected to be part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/NZGames2024]Made in New Zealand 2024 Games Festival[/url]! This celebration of local game development highlights the unique talent coming out of New Zealand, and we’re honored to be included alongside such amazing creators.

[h2]How You Can Support Us[/h2]
We're working hard on WRAIN to get it in your hands, you can help us by adding the game to your wishlist and joining our growing community. Every bit of support keeps us inspired and motivated as we bring this esoteric journey to life.

[h3]🛒Add WRAIN to Your Wishlist[/h3]
Stay updated and be the first to know about any new announcements, demos, or release dates by wishlisting the game!

[h3]💬 Join Our Discord[/h3]
Want to chat with fellow adventurers, discuss your theories, or get behind-the-scenes updates from the team? [url=https://discord.gg/gQQ2v7xSJ8]Join our Discord community![/url] We’d love to have you with us as we continue developing WRAIN.

[h3]A Note from the Developers:[/h3]
We’re so proud to be part of the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/NZGames2024]Made in New Zealand Games Festival[/url][/b], and we can’t wait to show you more of WRAIN in the coming months. From the entire team, thank you for your support! It means the world to us as we work to bring this supernatural adventure to life.

notes.title: Announcing WRAIN!
notes.content:
[h1]Announcing WRAIN![/h1]
[b]We’re proud to announce WRAIN[/b], a dark supernatural adventure where death is just the beginning. You’ll soon step into a world where each death unlocks new mysteries and forbidden knowledge. Set on a strange, forgotten island, WRAIN invites you to explore eerie landscapes, unravel intricate puzzles, and commune with lost souls, all while shaping your own fate.

[h2]Join the Journey on Discord[/h2]
We’d love for you to join our growing community on [url=https://discord.gg/gQQ2v7xSJ8]Discord[/url]. Whether you’re curious about the game’s progress or want to share theories and ideas with others, our Discord is the place to be. Chat with fellow explorers, connect with the developers, and get behind-the-scenes updates as we continue building the world of WRAIN.

[h2]Add WRAIN to Your Wishlist[/h2]
Although WRAIN isn’t ready for release just yet, you can add it to your wishlist now! This not only helps us tremendously, but also ensures you’ll be among the first to know when new updates, demos, or announcements drop. Sharing the game with your friends is the best way that you can help us right now. Your support means the world to us as we bring this esoteric journey to life.

[h3]Developer Note[/h3]
From all of us at Synergy Digital, we just want to say thank you for your interest in WRAIN. We’ve been pouring our hearts into creating an atmospheric adventure that challenges what it means to live, die, and discover. Though we’re still deep in development, we’re excited to share this journey with you. Every wishlist, comment, and piece of feedback from the community keeps us inspired as we continue crafting this world. We can’t wait to show you more in the coming months.

Stay tuned, and remember: in WRAIN, your end is just the beginning.
